name: Sun Mizrahi
bio:
Israeli beauty Sun Mizrahi has slowly inched her way up into the realms of industry elite. Making her mark on the runways of Milano for FW22, Sun walked for FENDI, BOTTEGA VENETA, BLUMARINE and went on to open JACQUEMUS in Aigues-Mortes. Sun returned the following season attending full-circuit and adding more iconic brands to her client list including TOMMY HILFIGER, MICHAEL KORS, CHRISTOPHER KANE, MAX MARA, DSQUARED2, MISSONI, ETRO, DIOR, HERMES and SACAI. From there, Mizrahi landed her walking shoes on all the major catwalks within the international fashion scene.

MDC placed Sun on their "Top 50" while she quickly became an editorial favorite, shooting for iconic publications including Vogue Italia, Harper's Bazaar Italia, Beyond Noise, System Beauty, Pop Magazine, Numero France and M le Magazine du Monde to name a few. Advertisers featuring the brunette stunner include BOTTEGA VENETA, ETRO, TOM FORD, MICHAEL KORS and most recently PHOEBE PHILO Collection C photographed by Sam Rock.
